doc.title: Houston Person Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

chapter: Influences: R&B, gospel and the church
title: Favorite gospel groups and singers
summary: He lists gospel groups and singers he admires and praises those who stay in gospel rather than chase secular success.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Name me some of them Gospel groups you like.
I love the Five Blind Boys.
Some of the current ones, you know, James Cleveland, I’m mad about the Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir.
There’s a lot of people out there that go unsung, you know, that we don’t hear about. And I’m in to a lot of those. Jermaine Hawkins.
Who I think is one of the greatest singers, regardless. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

Oh, the Wayans, you know there are a lot of them, you know, a lot of them. And a lot of them stay in the Gospel thing, they turn down what they consider to be more of a commercial success singing secular music, but they are true, they have a lot of integrity. I admire that too.
